newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ's Energy Brokers reports four-month profit.
newsitem.headline: NZ's Energy Brokers reports four-month profit.

text.p: Energy Brokers New Zealand Ltd said on Wednesday it had made a NZ$1.4 million net profit in the first four months of the year.
Energy Brokers, which plans to be an active trader in the wholesale electricity market when it starts on October 1, was established three years ago.
The company is 41 percent owned by Power Co Ltd, 21 percent by Hawkes Bay Power Ltd, 33 percent by Central Power and 5.0 percent by Wairoa Power Ltd.
General Manager Albert de Geest said the result was more than double expectations. -- Wellington Newsroom (64-4-4734746)
